clauses.heading: 1. Internship Details
clauses.text:
• Position: SDE - Intern
• Department: Professional Services
• Internship Start Date: 02-Mar-2026
• Duration: 10 weeks
• Working Hours: 15 hours per week
• Reporting To: Technical Lead
• Location: Bangalore
clauses.plain_english: This clause outlines the basic terms of the internship, including the role, department, start date, duration, weekly hours, reporting structure, and work location.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard descriptive clause defining the scope and logistics of the internship. It contains no punitive, financial, or restrictive terms.

clauses.heading: 2. Roles and Responsibilities
clauses.text:
During your internship, you will be expected to:
• Participate in onboarding and training sessions
• Work on assigned tasks/modules under the supervision of Technical Lead, under defined timelines
• Prepare reports, presentations, or summaries as required
• Follow coding standards / operational guidelines and attend meetings as needed
You are expected to perform your duties diligently and adhere to company policies and maintain a professional
conduct.
clauses.plain_english: This clause outlines the intern's core responsibilities, including training, task completion under supervision, reporting, and adherence to company standards and professional conduct.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause contains standard, reasonable expectations for an internship role and does not impose unusual or onerous burdens.
obligations: Participate in onboarding and training sessions
Work on assigned tasks/modules under the supervision of Technical Lead
Prepare reports, presentations, or summaries as required
Follow coding standards and operational guidelines

clauses.heading: 3. Confidentiality
clauses.text: Neutrinos Software Services Pvt Ltd is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Certified, demonstrating its commitment to international best practices in information security and data privacy. You are required to comply with the Neutrinos confidentiality and Non-disclosure agreement.
clauses.plain_english: The employee is required to follow the terms of the company's separate confidentiality and non-disclosure agreement.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause incorporates an external agreement by reference without providing the terms, creating uncertainty regarding the scope and duration of the confidentiality obligations.
obligations: Comply with the Neutrinos confidentiality and Non-disclosure agreement
clauses.ambiguity_reason: The clause refers to an external document ('the Neutrinos confidentiality and Non-disclosure agreement') that is not attached or defined within this text.

clauses.heading: 4. Code of Conduct
clauses.text: You are required to comply with all company rules, regulations, and policies. Any misconduct may result in termination of the internship.
clauses.plain_english: The intern must follow all company policies and rules; failing to do so could lead to the termination of their internship.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause grants the employer broad discretion to terminate the internship based on 'misconduct' without defining what constitutes misconduct, creating potential for arbitrary enforcement.
obligations: Comply with all company rules, regulations, and policies
clauses.ambiguity_reason: The term 'misconduct' is not defined, leaving it open to subjective interpretation by the employer.

clauses.heading: 5. Separation
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this internship with 7 days of written notice.
clauses.plain_english: Both the company and the intern have the right to end the internship early, provided they give the other party at least 7 days' notice in writing.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause provides a mutual right to terminate for convenience with a reasonable notice period, which is standard for internship agreements.
obligations: Provide 7 days of written notice prior to termination
